metaDescription: White-label WordPress and Elementor website for Brentwood Bay Resort: rooms, dining, spa, marina, weddings and events, with Cloudbeds online booking.
summary: WordPress website for an oceanfront boutique resort on Vancouver Island.
overview: Brentwood Bay Resort describes itself as a 33 room boutique resort on Vancouver Island's Brentwood Bay, minutes from downtown Victoria. Pixel2Tech built the resort's WordPress website as white-label development partner for a digital agency. The site brings rooms, restaurants, spa, marina and events together under one booking button.
challenge: The resort is several businesses in one: a hotel, two restaurants and room service, a spa, a marina with boat tours and rentals, and a wedding and events venue. Each needs its own pages, while the main action for most visitors is still to book a stay.
approach: A seasonal announcement bar sits above a header with Resort, Dining, Spa, Marina, Weddings and Events and News and Calendar menus, plus a Book Now button that opens Cloudbeds reservations. The home page uses a full-screen photo hero, a rooms introduction, then alternating split panels for dining, spa and marina, each linking to its sub-pages. A calendar carousel of promotions and events, a community giving section and a newsletter sign-up lead into the footer.
outcome: A resort website where guests can explore rooms, dining, spa treatments and boat trips, check upcoming events and book a stay from any page. The Elementor build lets the resort team swap seasonal banners and calendar entries without developer help.

results.label: Key pages
results.value: Rooms, dining, spa, marina, events, booking

process.title: Site map
process.body: Menus split the resort into rooms and activities, three dining options, spa treatments and memberships, marina tours and rentals, and weddings, meetings and corporate events.

process.title: Home page
process.body: A full-screen hero with Book Now leads to a rooms introduction, then dark green panels for dining, spa and marina that alternate with full-height photos.

process.title: Events and booking
process.body: A carousel lists dated promotions and events with Learn More links, and every Book Now button points to the resort's Cloudbeds reservation page.

process.title: Mobile
process.body: On phones the announcement bar stays on top, the menu becomes a single icon and the hero keeps the resort name and Book Now button in the first screen.

whyItMatters: Resort guests plan around more than a room: meals, treatments and time on the water. Showing each of those clearly, with booking always one click away, helps a browsing visitor turn into a reservation.

faqs.q: What is the Brentwood Bay Resort website built with?
faqs.a: It runs on WordPress with Elementor on a Hello Elementor child theme, with room reservations handled through Cloudbeds and the newsletter form through Gravity Forms.

faqs.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. We build websites and Shopify stores under the agency's brand, with an NDA when needed. Tell us about the project and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
